jobs.title: Head of Product Design
jobs.description:
ABOUT DUALENTRY

DualEntry is building the OS for finance.

Every business needs a financial system of record, yet the world's largest fintech market ($220B+) still runs on software from the 1990s. DualEntry's AI-native ERP automates accounting from data entry to close, so finance teams move faster, spend less and incur less risk.

In just 2 years we've raised $100M+ from Lightspeed, Khosla Ventures, Contrary and Google Ventures and earned the trust of customers from $5M ARR to publicly traded companies.

We hire outliers - people who have achieved difficult things, in their careers or beyond. You'll find leaders, colleagues who've competed at the highest levels of sport, performed on Broadway, trained with UFC champions and founded the country’s largest Python community.

 


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS NOW






WHERE YOU'LL CREATE IMPACT

 - Own the end-to-end design vision and execution across the DualEntry platform, from web to mobile

 - Lead and grow the design function, setting a high bar for craft, UX, and product quality

 - Translate complex financial workflows into simple, intuitive experiences

 - Build and evolve a scalable, component-based design system in Figma

 - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and founders to shape product direction and ship quickly

 - Bring user insights into product decisions through research, testing, and customer feedback

 - Define how design operates at DualEntry — team structure, processes, standards, and ways of working

 - Continuously improve how we design, prototype, and ship




WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS

 - Hardcore work ethic and high agency

 - 8+ years designing complex SaaS products end-to-end with at least 2+ years' operating at a senior or leadership level

 - Deep experience with Figma and scalable design systems

 - Strong UX thinking, interaction design, and attention to visual detail

 - Comfort working with HTML/CSS/JavaScript

 - Ability to make fast, pragmatic decisions

 - Bonus if you have experience designing fintech, accounting, or enterprise SaaS tools




WHY YOU’LL THRIVE HERE

 - Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

 - You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

 - Your feedback shapes the product directly

 - High-speed, high-trust environment with high expectations
   
   


MEET THE TEAM

 - Andy https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrewscottwoods/, Head of Product - under his leadership the team increased the customer win rate by focusing on the SaaS vertical, shipped the first comprehensive ERP documentation website, focused in on quality as our number one feature, and much more. Andy kicked off DualEntry's Ctrl+AI series, helping accounting professionals learn about  in-production AI-native workflows.

 - Bram https://www.linkedin.com/in/bramanto-setyaki-68b59645/ Founding Product Designer, designed DualEntry's AI agent end to end and built the core of the product's design system.

 - Sudarshan https://www.linkedin.com/in/srsiyengar/ went from new hire to presenting design direction to the entire company within 2 weeks of joining.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Equity: $80,000 - $100,000

 - Base salary: $180,000 - $275,000

 - 1Medical, dental & vision insurance

 - One Medical membership

 - Mental health support (Talkspace)

 - Fertility & family-building support (Kindbody)

 - Virtual healthcare (Teladoc Health)

 - 401(k) benefits

 - Commuter benefits

 - Learning & development budget for courses, certifications & language learning

 - Unlimited AI tokens

 - AI skills development & enablement

 - Visa & permanent residence sponsorship

 - Relocation support for employees moving to New York

 - Flexible PTO (27 days, including public holidays)

 - Collaborative, in-office culture with no bureaucracy

 - Snacks, drinks, team events & more


We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a restructure like this once in a lifetime.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!
